dialogues.speaker: Rather Aged Notes
dialogues.text: (These notes seem to have been plundered during a recent raid on the Fatui. The age of these notes has made the words difficult to recognize.)

dialogues.speaker: Rather Aged Notes
dialogues.text: "...The Inspector flew into a rage and slashed Katsuragi. The great blade cut deep into the flesh... cast his own nagamaki into the furnace's flame..."

dialogues.speaker: Rather Aged Notes
dialogues.text: "...Nozomu could not abide by that order, and drew the completely melted weapon out of the furnace... He was horribly burned..."
